test_summary.coverage_note: Full-suite coverage cannot be measured: process-spawning tests deadlock under coverage instrumentation. Pure-mock subset (4/8 files) = 19% line coverage.

features.evidence: main.py:14 unconditional `import wmi` (Windows-only) crashes import on Linux/macOS; main.py:291 `subprocess.Popen(['start','cmd','/k',...])` is Windows shell; main.py:113-114 calls start_streaming() then connected_event.wait() which blocks forever if start_streaming() returns False (timeout).

All 6 controller signals wired (streamsense_ui.py:325-330); all buttons functional. But ui file is monolithic 771 LOC with 28 inline setStyleSheet blocks and duplicated stylesheets; hardcoded geometry (1400x900, 450px). Controller emits FAKE signal-quality (92/87/85 at controller.py:250,268,295).

find_devices.py provides find_muses_with_ports/find_muse/find_empatica/scan_bluetooth/scan_wifi/serial_ports. Threads in find_empatica not joined; fixed-time sleeps; unique_ports appended inside loop. serial_helper.py (846 LOC) handles cross-platform termios well but is 0% tested.

Inherits BaseStreamer correctly. stream_muse.py:310 passes self._monitor_connection(...) (a CALL result) as thread target instead of a callable; per-sample threading.Timer creation (stream_muse.py:250-251) is unbounded. muse_helper.py uses Windows-only `start bluemuse:` shell calls and is 0% covered.

UI path BROKEN: streamsense_controller.py:258-262 calls StreamE4(device_id=..., output_path=...) but signature is StreamE4(e4, root_output_folder, synchronized_start_time) (stream_e4.py:40) -> TypeError at runtime, swallowed as 'Failed to connect'. CLI path works (main.py:171 positional). e4_helper.py:26 hardcoded Windows EXE path 'D:/E4StreamingServer.../EmpaticaBLEServer.exe'.

Cleanest streamer (full _stream_wrapper + _setup_lsl_outlets, graceful import fallback). Wired into UI controller (controller.py:283-289 signature matches). NOT wired into CLI (main.py has 0 references to bitalino). No dedicated test file; 0% coverage.
Abstract base (ABC) with Process/Event/Queue lifecycle, start_streaming(timeout)->bool, stop_streaming with join/terminate/kill escalation, context-manager protocol. All 3 streamers inherit it.

Resolves LSL streams, pulls chunks, writes resizable HDF5, exports pickle datasets (MNE RawArray for EEG). Reachable from main.py:204 and controller.py:373. Complex daemon-thread disconnect handling; interpolation of missing data is risky.

view_streams.py reachable from main.py:311/407 (93% covered). plot_streams.py vispy/GLSL Canvas is full-featured but 0% covered and spawns subprocess windows. plot_helper.py is a 4-line/54-byte stub (run_vispy).

data_processor.py:606-607 executes DataProcessor('D:/Study Data/...').process_and_synchronize_data() at MODULE IMPORT time -> FileNotFoundError; this crashes `import data_processor` and breaks collection of tests/test_data_processor.py. Also never invoked from any entry point.
event_logger.py (30 LOC) and stream_info.py implement near-identical log_event; launched only via main.py:285-291 with Windows-only `start cmd /k`. Not integrated with app lifecycle/state.

component_statuses.event_logger.py: Should be Archived (duplicate of stream_info.py logic)

features.evidence: PsychoPy paradigm reachable from main.py:219. Hardcoded refresh_rate=59.95 and window dims; LSL marker sync unverified; no tests. 8 JPG slides misplaced in Logs/ likely belong as experiment assets.

synchronized_start_time = pylsl.local_clock() captured per entry point and threaded through streamers. Documented heavily (docs/MULTI_DEVICE_SYNCHRONIZATION_GUIDE.md) but correctness depends on per-device clock handling that is uneven (E4 uses elapsed-from-first-sample, Muse uses IRLS correction). Not validated by tests.

4 overlapping screenshot generators. capture_screenshots_headless.py is redundant (partial mock) -> Should be Archived. docs/screenshots/09 and 10 PNGs are byte-identical (md5 e4bf6724...). All 10 PNGs share identical 3,787,081-byte size (suspect near-duplicate exports).

Good mock layer (MockMuse/MockE4/MockLSL/data_generators). But: process-spawning tests make the full suite hang under coverage; test_data_processor errors at collection; no tests for stream_bitalino, recorder (1 trivial test), muse_helper (0%), serial_helper (0%), data_processor, UI, CLI. No CI workflow present.
